changelog:
- Initial release with support for interacting with GitHub using the gh CLI for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries.
- Integrates access to 50+ AI models, including capabilities for image and video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music creation, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS operations through the SkillBoss API.
- Includes detailed API usage documentation and example Bash commands for each feature area.
- Supports model auto-selection for optimal cost or quality via smart routing.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication across all features.
